primary.description: High-quality LM Studio embeddings for semantic search

setup: 1. Edit this file to configure your preferred embedding providers
2. Configure 'primary' for your main embedding service
3. Configure 'fallback' for backup when primary fails
4. For Ollama: Make sure model is pulled (ollama pull nomic-embed-text:latest)
5. For LM Studio: Load an embedding model and update base_url if needed
6. For OpenAI: Add your API key

providers.lm_studio: High quality embeddings, best for semantic search
providers.ollama: Fast local embeddings, good for development
providers.openai: Premium quality but requires internet and API costs

instructions.preservation_note: Existing embeddings are preserved automatically - new embeddings use your configured providers
